title: Collecting the Borderland Science Research Association archive

tellings.quote:
I went to Eureka, California.
>> I met with this guy in his garage
>> and we packed it all together and sent
it back to Sweden.

plain: The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn says he travelled to Eureka, California, to collect the archive of the Borderland Science Research Association, an American group that gathered material on UFOs and fringe science. He tells Michels he met the keeper of the papers in his garage, and they "packed it all together and sent it back to Sweden," which is how that collection came to be held there.
